statement: Consumers frequently underestimate how many recurring subscriptions they pay for and their total monthly cost, leading to unnoticed financial drain.
normalized_problem: Underestimating total subscription count and monthly spending
desired_outcome: Gain complete visibility over all active recurring subscriptions and total monthly recurring expenses in one place.
current_solutions: Subscription management apps (e.g., Rocket Money, PocketGuard)
attempts: Reviewing bank and credit card statements manually
Setting up custom Google Sheets or Excel templates
solution_complaints: Full budgeting apps add unnecessary complexity when users only want subscription tracking
Some apps fail to detect or track certain recurring bills automatically
